payload.content: A weighted base keeps this 6.5-inch solid brass countertop paper towel holder steady for one-handed tearing, while the roll stands upright to save space on the counter. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Designed as a freestanding paper towel stand (no wall mounting), it’s a practical alternative when you don’t want an under cabinet paper towel holder. The Carolina Collection pairs a traditional look with contemporary design elements, making it easy to coordinate with classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware throughout the home. A felt pad on the base helps prevent scratching on your surfaces, and the included paper towel holder arrives with no assembly required. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty from Allied Brass.
